title: Lunar Prospector
credit: Echoes of Exploration team (modelled in code from NASA reference drawings and photos)
note: Lunar Prospector in mapping orbit: a 1.37 m wide, 1.28 m tall graphite-epoxy drum covered in solar cells, the 1.57 m antenna mast on its spin axis (slotted medium-gain antenna with the omni cone on top), and three 2.5 m lattice booms carrying the gamma-ray spectrometer, the neutron and alpha-particle spectrometers, and the electron reflectometer with the magnetometer on a 1.1 m extension. Six thrusters, launch adapter ring, Sun and limb sensors. Simplified: instrument shapes are approximate; the three fuel tanks are inside the drum and not shown.
